name: Nachtflohmarkt Messe Erfurt

rhythm.en: About once a month, on a Saturday

facts: indoors on the Erfurt exhibition grounds, described by the venue as the largest antiques and second-hand market in Thuringia
entry 3.00 EUR, 2.00 EUR reduced for children and visitors with a disability card
tram line 2 runs from the Anger in the city centre to the exhibition grounds every 10 minutes
about 3,500 parking spaces at the venue, parking 5.00 EUR
19 accessible parking spaces near the main entrance; step-free access through the foyer
arrival for this market is via the west car park
notes: Facts read from the venue's own pages (Messe Erfurt GmbH), which host the market and name the organiser; the organiser's own domain flohmarkt-wagner.de redirects to a marktcom listing page, so it was not used as the source. The event page says 'Tickets ab 3,50 €' while the venue FAQ says 3,00 € normal / 2,00 € reduced — recorded 3 EUR, the door price. End time 23:45 is the calendar entry's; the same page also promotes a free-entry 'Antik- & Trödelmarkt' on the grounds with no dates published. No 2027 dates yet.

description.de: Etwa einmal im Monat samstags ab 16 Uhr bis in die Nacht, in den Hallen der Messe Erfurt — nach Angaben des Hauses Thüringens größter Antik- und Trödelmarkt. Sammlerstücke und Antiquitäten. Eintritt 3 Euro, ermäßigt 2. Die Tram 2 fährt alle zehn Minuten vom Anger zum Gelände.
description.en: About once a month on a Saturday from 4 in the afternoon into the night, in the halls of Messe Erfurt — the venue calls it Thuringia's largest antiques and second-hand market. Collectors' pieces and antiques. Entry 3 euros, 2 reduced. Tram 2 runs from the Anger every ten minutes.
